Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The findings indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (>100,000 CFU/mL E. coli), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), positive nitrites, hematuria, and presence of bacteria. The low specific gravity may suggest dilute urine. Glucosuria is noted and may warrant further evaluation for hyperglycemia or diabetes. No ketones or casts detected. Clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy are recommended.
